value: U.S. Department of Energy (2022). Industrial Decarbonization Roadmap. DOE/EE-2635. Washington, DC: U.S. Department of Energy, September 2022.

A 200-page roadmap, mostly narrative and scenario results. Main file: Table 3, the CO2 factors of SMR hydrogen used as fuel with and without CCUS at the roadmap's three capture levels. Sidecar _capture-cost (not loaded): Table 2, near- and medium-term CO2 capture cost estimates by industry in $/MT (min-average-max); the table does not say whether the cost is per tonne captured or avoided, nor the dollar year, and it is compiled from Supekar and Skerlos 2014, Psarras et al. 2017, Zang et al. 2021, EPA GHGRP and GCCSI 2021 (footnote 108), so it is kept out of the main file. Capturable CO2 counts only facilities above 100,000 t/yr with capture cost below $200/t, and process CO2 only except for power plants. The sector chapters' scenario pathways and Table 1 (technology pillars) carry no per-technology parameters.
